subject: Why is a variable not found?

messages.author: 473c4ce8ca8f75f2
messages.subject: Why is a variable not found?
parts:
Hello again

Maybe I am missing something obvious .... it won't be the first time, especially not with R!

But

qplot(days, MC3aR/C3a, geom = "point", data = multiobs, color = Patient_Name)

yields an error that

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object "Patient_Name" not found


but

attach(multiobs)
qplot(days, MC3aR/C3a, geom = "point", color = Patient_Name)


does exactly what I thought it would do.

perplexedly yours

Peter
